digest.component_or_area: plan review attestation and manifest signing
propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit deterministic canonical signed pins binding the review to direct children and direct prerequisites without adding ticket fields or user commands

Plan-material-pin manifest lines must appear in deterministic order after verified-at-sha with role (child or prerequisite), canonical ticket ID, and 16-hex material fingerprint, with duplicate edges collapsing within each role

PlanRelationSnapshot must build one store-wide preload of all ticket states including archived states to discover inbound blockers, then collect normalized relations with exact role and fingerprint carriers before any LLM evaluation

Unreadable or unresolvable targets must return unsigned INDETERMINATE with specific PlanRelationSnapshotError reasons (missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, store-read-failure) before any LLM call

tracker_head_sha must verify clean tickets-tracker state using git status --porcelain and ls-files -u, then capture 40-hex HEAD SHA, mapping all git/IO/path/subprocess/output failures to store-read-failure

Ordinary sign, progressive refresh, and re-sign paths must all invoke collect_plan_relation_snapshot and emit the complete current pin set, with deleted pinned targets preventing refresh/re-sign until relationship repair
